messages.content: Who won the chess tournament in 2015?

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

message.content: I’m not sure which tournament you’re asking about. Could you let me know which specific chess event you’re referring to (e.g., World Chess Championship, Chess Olympiad, World Rapid/Blitz Championship, etc.)?
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Who won the chess tournament in 2015?" This is ambiguous: which chess tournament? There are many tournaments each year. Possibly they refer to the World Chess Championship 2015? That was between Magnus Carlsen and Sergey Karjakin. Carlsen won. But the question might refer to the Chess Olympiad 2015? That was held in Baku, Azerbaijan. The team gold went to Russia. Or maybe they refer to the World Rapid Chess Championship 2015? That was won by Magnus Carlsen. Or maybe they refer to the World Blitz Chess Championship 2015? That was won by Vladimir Kramnik. Or maybe they refer to the Chess.com Speed Chess tournament? Hard to guess.

We need to ask clarifying question. The user didn't specify which tournament. So we should ask: "Which chess tournament are you referring to? For example, the World Chess Championship, Chess Olympiad, etc."
